Name: Badass Sam for Seasonal Villager Outfits -DEPRECATED SEE DESCRIPTION-
Author: Inawordyes
Description:
[size=4]UPDATE 7/27/20: This mod is now being maintained as a sub-mod under the main [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2449]Seasonal Villager Outfits[/url] mod page. As such, this standalone version is now deprecated and will no longer be updated. Many thanks to ParadigmNomad for updating this mod with the latest SVO changes to Sam, and also for taking on the responsibility of maintaining this moving forward.[/size]

--------------------

This is a Content Patcher-ported version (courtesy of ParadigmNomad) of Apogirl02's "Badass Sam" mod, which is itself a compilation of Thalabee's "Sam and the Great Hair" and BigReaps' "Alternative Sam" mods, intended to be used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2449]Seasonal Villager Outfits[/url] (SVO).

I made this for my own use and thought others may like it as well!

Much thanks to all the above for their hand in creating the original mods, thalabee in particular for giving me permission to upload this, and to ParadigmNomad and ᵉ for helping me troubleshoot issues over on Discord.

Requires SVO and Content Patcher.

Original mods:

[list]
[*][u][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/657/?]Sam and the Great Hair[/url][/size][/u] (Hairstyle) by Thalabee
[*][u][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1483/?tab=2&navtag=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmodfiles%2F%3Fid%3D1483&pUp=1]Alternative Sam[/url][/size][/u] (Haircolor) by BigReaps
[*][size=3][u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1606]Badass Sam[/url]﻿[/u][/size] (compilation of the above, of which this is based on) by Apolline
[/list]
